text: The cause of all this noise. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a white borzoi puppy. <break time="0.8s" /> With a sharp nose. <break time="0.8s" /> And a yellow spot on its back. <break time="0.8s" /> It sat in the middle of the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> With its front legs spread. <break time="0.8s" /> Shaking from head to tail. <break time="0.8s" /> In its watery eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a look of misery and terror. <break time="0.8s" /> I was walking along quietly, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> Not bothering anyone. <break time="0.8s" /> Began Khryukin the goldsmith. <break time="0.8s" /> Coughing into his fist. <break time="0.8s" /> I was talking about some firewood. <break time="0.8s" /> With Mitry Mitrich. <break time="0.8s" /> When this nasty dog suddenly bit my finger. <break time="0.8s" /> For no reason. <break time="0.8s" /> I am a working man. <break time="0.8s" /> And my work is delicate. <break time="0.8s" /> So I may not be able to use this finger. <break time="0.8s" /> For a week. <break time="0.8s" /> You must make the owner pay me, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> For there is no law. <break time="0.8s" /> That says we must suffer from beasts. <break time="0.8s" /> If every dog were allowed. <break time="0.8s" /> To bite people. <break time="0.8s" /> Life would not be worth living. <break time="0.8s" /> In this world. <break time="0.8s" /> Ochumelov frowned and said sternly. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose dog is this. <break time="0.8s" /> I will not let this pass. <break time="0.8s" /> And its owner will pay a heavy fine. <break time="0.8s" /> Yeldyrin, find out whose dog it is and write a report. <break time="0.8s" /> Since it may be mad. <break time="0.8s" /> And must be destroyed at once.
